name: PJ Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km half-marathon held on September 6, 2026, at Laman MBPJ, Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 6, 2026, in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. The race starts at Laman MBPJ and covers a distance of 21.1 km. Registration for this event is currently open, allowing runners to sign up ahead of the race date.
pros: Registration is currently open, giving runners ample time to plan and sign up
Held at a central, accessible venue, Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya
Offers a standard, well-recognized half-marathon distance of 21.1 km

research_highlights: One of Malaysia's oldest half marathons (35th edition held in 2025, 36th edition scheduled for 2026), organised by Petaling Jaya City Council (MBPJ) and Puncak Ventures
Course is undulating/hilly, circulating through PJ town; one runner logged about 222m of elevation gain over the 30km route
Categories include 30km, 21km (half marathon), 10km, 5km fun run and a 1km costume-themed fun run, starting from Laman MBPJ
Very early flag-off times to beat the heat: 30km at 3:30am, 21km at 3:45am, 10km at 7:00am, 5km at 7:15am, with cut-offs of 5hrs/4hrs/2hrs/1hr respectively
Multiple race reports describe hot, humid conditions typical of a Malaysian morning road race, with runners splashing water on themselves to cool down
research_watchouts: Hot and humid weather is repeatedly mentioned by participants, even with pre-dawn starts
The route is hilly/undulating with slopes throughout, described by one runner as manageable but still hilly
Course can get crowded around the halfway point where the 10km category and other runners merge in
At least one recent participant publicly requested improvements to on-course support/hydration stations

faqs.question: When is the PJ Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. The event will be held in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia, starting from Laman MBPJ. Runners interested in participating should note this date and confirm registration availability ahead of time, since registration is currently listed as open for this race.

faqs.question: Where does the race start?
faqs.answer: The race starts at Laman MBPJ, located in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the starting point for the 2026 edition of the PJ Half Marathon, which covers a distance of 21.1 km through the city of Petaling Jaya on September 6, 2026.

faqs.question: What distance is offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 offers a single distance option of 21.1 km, which is the standard half-marathon distance. This distance is the primary and only race category listed for this event, taking place at Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia on September 6, 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the PJ Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Interested runners can sign up to participate in the 21.1 km half-marathon, which will be held on September 6, 2026, starting at Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia.
